capabilities.title: Video generation from text prompts or image inputs
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Pixelle Video: text-to-video and image-to-video generation model
capabilities.reason: Pixelle's script, image/video generation, TTS, music, and FFmpeg composition pipeline is a full media-authoring product. Nexus has no governed video-authoring lane or artifact lifecycle.

capabilities.title: Video understanding: frame analysis, caption generation, and scene segmentation
capabilities.reason: Nexus has no governed video-file intake, decoder, scene-artifact retention, or vision-model lane. The current upstream is primarily an automated video creation engine, not a drop-in Nexus analysis boundary.

capabilities.title: Integrate video context into LLM prompts alongside text and images
capabilities.sourceEvidence: Pixelle Video multimodal context: video frames as LLM input
capabilities.reason: Injecting decoded frames into prompts requires explicit media consent, file limits, frame provenance, retention, and provider-policy controls that the current text/image context contract does not provide.
